scope: TG2 post-training materialization, integrity gating, and frozen evaluation orchestration
pipeline: For every training parent completed on North, transfer the complete run tree into an incoming directory, verify every source hash, and atomically install it on East.
For a training parent completed on East, satisfy materialization without a transfer.
Require all nine materialization tasks before running the frozen matrix-integrity verifier and the seed-independence extension.
Require the joint integrity marker before releasing any of the nine frozen 1,200-episode evaluation jobs.
Run evaluations only on Robot-East-H20, where the admitted renderer and materialized checkpoints are available.
safety: An existing incomplete destination is never deleted or overwritten.
North transfers are serialized by a shared file lock and installed only after full-tree hash verification.
Final model and optimizer state must each exceed one billion bytes and trainer_state must report exactly step 20000.
Evaluation cannot become resource-eligible from checkpoint existence alone; both integrity audits must pass.
